name: Trace Width & Current/Thermal Advisor
description: Checks PCB trace widths against IPC-2221 current-carrying capacity and estimates I2R-based thermal hotspots across copper.
description_full: A KiCad 9 action plugin that reads the active PCB layout, computes the minimum safe trace width for each net using IPC-2221 formulas (copper weight and permissible temperature rise aware), flags undersized traces, and builds an approximate thermal risk map from I2R heating across all copper features. Results are shown in a ranked table inside KiCad; flagged nets can be selected/highlighted directly on the board.
